Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 20: the slip of [[Tatooine Utility Belt (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on Han or a Lars. Character cannot be targeted by [Permanent Weapon] weapons or be captured. If just lost, place this device in Used Pile. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed must come from Reserve Deck (if possible) and may not be reduced below 2.”), word for word the text of [[Tatooine Utility Belt (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
